concepts.anchor: After the `POST /v1/customFields/removeKey` paragraph in `## Entity scope and persistence` -> `### Custom-field key creation contract`.
concepts.proposed_markdown: Bearer-authenticated `POST /v1/customFields/deleteValues` removes the values for specified field keys from one selected entity instance while preserving its other custom fields. The payload targets an entity type, entity ID, and array of keys. This value-level operation is distinct from `removeKey`, which removes a key from the allowlist across an entity type and makes existing values under that key inaccessible. [[source-metronome-api-reference-custom-fields-delete-custom-fields]]
